thread:
Maya (Presales): Heads-up 30 new POC request from Meridian Market. 72-hour trial next week. Scope: streaming cart personalization, a refund tool-call path wired to their order service, and strict JSON schema for order events to our webhook. They also want pricing ballpark and answers to a short security questionnaire.
Diego (Eng): For minimal POC footprint: - ephemeral API token (TTL 10m) issued by our token service - streaming over SSE or WebSocket (we'll provide both) - tool-call `initiate_refund` with signed HMAC payload to their webhook - simple webhook consumer in Docker.
Rina (SDK): I'll prep Node + Python examples. Node example for SSE stream:```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const c = new Redwood({token: process.env.POC_TOKEN});
const s = c.stream({model:'retail-stream-v1', input:'cart_update', onData: d => console.log(d)});
// register tool handler
c.registerTool('initiate_refund', async (args) => { return await fetch(process.env.REFUND_API, {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify(args)}); });
```
Maya (Presales): Their infra lead flagged that corporate proxy rewrites headers and they might not pass Authorization on upgrade. Any fallback?
Diego (Eng): We can sign the connection URL with an HMAC query param that the SDK attaches. Not ideal but works for short POCs. We'll also add an advise block in the runbook about websocket sticky sessions and proxy pass-through checks.
Owen (Sec): Security Qs: They asked about PII handling, logs, and key storage. For the POC: redact personal identifiers in sample data, do not persist full carts in telemetry (only hashed ids), and ephemeral tokens are stored server side only. We can provide our SOC2/ISO packet but note that private deployment required for KMS/HSM integration.
Maya (Presales): Pricing ask: "Estimate cost for 50 concurrent shoppers with peaks to 200 QPS" 30 need a simple slide.
Diego (Eng): Rough calc: assume avg response 250 tokens, 2 requests/min per active shopper, with batching/caching we estimate token rate around 0.6-1.2 tokens/sec per active connection. For 50 concurrent this is small, but peak bursts to 200 QPS suggest recommending Dedicated pilot or quota bump. I'll put numbers in a spreadsheet.
Rina (SDK): Also adding structured-output assertions: sample JSON schema for order event and snippet to validate with `ajv` after each message. Example assertion: `ajv.validate(schema, msg)`. We'll ship a prebuilt schema in the repo.
Legal-bot: Reminder: attach NDA or approval before sending production data.
Maya (Presales): Action items: Diego -> runbook + docker webhook; Rina -> SDK demo + schema + curl examples; Owen -> security answers + redaction checklist; Diego/Rina -> signed-URL fallback snippet. Meeting to sync tomorrow 10:30.
Diego (Eng): Noted. Potential blocker: their proxy also terminates TLS and reissues certs, so mutual-TLS option won't work unless their infra permits passthrough. Will call that out.
Rina (SDK): One-liner curl to get ephemeral token for demo:```bash
curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.ai/v1/ephemeral -H 'Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>' -d '{"role":"meridian-poc","ttl":600}'
```
Owen (Sec): I'll redact the sample CSV they sent and convert to synthetic data. Also confirm telemetry retention for POC is 7 days.
Maya (Presales): Great. Please assemble a 1-page POC runbook and a 2-slide pricing note I can send to the buyer today. I'll loop in Meridian infra and schedule the kickoff after you upload artifacts.
